Hi Elena — thanks for sending these over and for the quick follow-up. I can confirm we received the VAT certificate and the spreadsheet.

Short answers up front:
- If Fabrica has an EU VAT registration for the country where you operate, we can record that and invoices will be issued net of Redwood VAT (reverse charge may apply depending on country rules). If you are not VAT-registered in an EU member state, we typically require either a local tax rep or invoices to include local VAT (and Redwood will treat the invoice per tax rules).
- Our accounts payable team prefers UBL/PEPPOL e-invoice or a structured CSV that maps the PO number, line items, VAT breakdown, and supplier VAT reg. I'll attach our PO template for reference.
- Required PO header fields: vendor legal name, VAT reg (VATIN/VAT number), billing country, remit bank details, and a PO reference line for GL coding.

Next steps for Fabrica (please):
1) Confirm the VAT number exactly as shown on the certificate (we'll mirror it into the vendor record).
2) Fill the vendor onboarding form linked here (secure form): https://redwood.company/vendor-onboard/form/submit/XXXXX
3) Return the bank details in the XLS you already attached — we only accept vendor bank details via spreadsheet or secure portal for SSO traceability.
4) If you plan to invoice via e-invoice, let us know if you use PEPPOL (we can share our endpoint).

I'm looping in Monica from finance to advise on whether we need a tax rep in Italy specifically.

Onward — I expect this will be a straightforward vendor setup once Monica confirms.

Thanks,
Karthik

Hi Elena — thanks again and apologies for the internal delay while we validated a couple of items. Final checklist and next steps from Redwood so we can kick off PO creation:

1) Vendor record fields we will populate from your attachments: legal name, VAT number (VATIN), EORI, billing country, and bank details. Please confirm the VAT number below exactly as on the certificate: IT12345678901 (confirm or correct).

2) Vendor onboarding form (secure): https://redwood.company/vendor-onboard/form/submit/XXXXX — please complete and upload the signed VAT cert into that form. This step triggers our vendor verification workflow.

3) PO / invoicing guidance:
   - If Fabrica invoices Redwood with an EU VAT number on file and the supply is B2B, we will process invoices net of VAT and apply the reverse-charge accounting treatment (tax code: RC-EU).
   - If you do not have an EU VAT reg for the billing country, Redwood requires either: a) a local VAT registration to be provided, or b) evidence of an appointed fiscal representative (tax rep) if local law mandates it. If neither is present, invoices will need to include local VAT and Redwood will process them with tax paid.
   - For e-invoice: we can accept PEPPOL UBL (preferred) or a CSV that matches our PO template. If you plan PEPPOL, share your participant ID and we'll give you our endpoint.

4) Attachments we are sending for your reference: Redwood_PO_Template.docx (please check the PO-number placeholder and remit fields), and a brief PDF explaining how reverse-charge will appear on our payment remittance.

5) Timeline: once you submit the vendor form and confirm the VAT number + bank details in the spreadsheet, AP usually issues the PO within 2 business days (subject to verification and sanction screening).

6) Contacts: Monica (finance) will be your AP contact for the onboarding verification: monica.patel@redwood.ai. Ben will run bank validation and sanction checks.

If this works, please: a) confirm VAT number, b) complete the vendor form, and c) indicate whether you will send e-invoices or simple PDF invoices.

Thanks and looking forward to getting Fabrica set up.

Best,
